interesting question because
I think you attempted to make a moral
judgment on creation of profit.
And so to argue against private equity,
in my opinion, is to argue against
capitalism.
And so if you think that private equity
is bad, private equity is also just
another term for private ownership. And
so do we think that private ownership
has been overall good or overall bad?
Well, all we have to do is look at
places that do not allow private
ownership or capitalism and do we think
that people have more good in those
societies versus the ones that have more
free markets and more capitalism? And
the argument for me is pretty stark
black and white in terms of capitalism

perfect world, want to damn the one that
